title: CLAUDE.md round-3 sentences match the owner's ruling: done at the first pass, round 3 only after a round 2 fail
why:
Ruling r9 (owner chat 18:35 CST Nov 13, "that's correct", relayed by the consultant 18:36 CST): "A change is done at the first round that passes, guard or check changes included. A fix after a pass, lint-only or a finding fix, is checked by a fix verifier, and its pass ends review. Round 3 runs only when round 2 FAILS." Page item 833 (record own-833-a-done-at-fix-check, 15:03 CST Nov 14) chose the same reading for a fix check after a failed round. Three CLAUDE.md sentences still say otherwise (read by triage in /root/claude-settings-main/CLAUDE.md, 00:48 CST Nov 15): in roles-review-cap-three, "Only a guard or check change fixed under a fix verifier also waits for round 3" and "unless a guard or check change still owes round 3 (item 402 a)"; in roles-third-round-steps-up, "A pass in round 1 or 2 calls for round 3 only on a guard or check change that got a fix verifier". r9 itself names the first clause as stale and "owner's yes needed"; the owner's yes is r9's "that's correct" plus item 833 a. Runner 10 was told at 00:46 CST Nov 15 that the rule reads per r9, not the old sentences (coordinator, relayed). The merge tool already follows r9 (steps merge-lint-fix-no-round-3, rounds-rules-one-record; triage read no code). Related open step: root-clause-done-at-fix-check (item 833's rewrite); check at hand-in whether this lane replaces or finishes it. Lane started 00:48 CST Nov 15 (consultant's relay; session id verified by get_session 00:48 CST: lane claude-md-round3-stale, running, branch claude-md-round3-stale, parent the coordinator). Stopped 00:54 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed): lane session_013NEJKyz4g3abVfp77T7hNV pushed nothing; its text goes into the consultant's workflow PR. OPEN POINT (triage read decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 and merge.py by grep, 00:54 CST): own-833-a settles the PASS case (a fix check pass after a failed round 1 ends review, no round 3), so decision line 15 is right for passes. Nothing settles the FAIL case: decision line 38, pr-review-record line 58 and merge.py round_three_refusal open round 3 after a failed round 1 when every fix verifier fails, while r9 says round 3 runs only when round 2 fails. Item 858 (no round recorded) is a different question; own-741-a covers only a lint fix after a pass. The text should name this case, or the owner rules on it.

01:15 CST Nov 15 (note from this lane, relayed by the coordinator, data): rule roles-third-round-steps-up still says "after review round 2 fails" and does not name the failed-round-1 route in the Round 3 of 3 brief line. PR 3464 (this lane): REST at about 01:15 CST, open draft, head c8a2b89327f8, base db3134aba78d, clean, 3 commits; its body says it rewrites roles-review-cap-three and roles-third-round-steps-up and the GLOSSARY fix verifier row, round 2 (sonnet) PASS on b7c279a5 (an older head). Unread: whether head c8a2b893 names the failed-round-1 route in the brief line. [01:17 CST Nov 15, coordinator 01:18, planning] PR 3464 and lane settings-docs-stale-switch-text edit the same CLAUDE.md line 35, so the lane pushes after 3464 merges. 01:54 CST Nov 15 (coordinator 01:53, relayed): runner 10 reads PR #3464's review record as 'open: the fix check must run on sonnet, not claude-sonnet-5-5'; the coordinator sent its lane to re-post the record in the tool's form. GitHub read by triage at 01:54 CST: #3464 is an open draft, head c8a2b89327f8, base db3134aba78d (main has moved past it), 3 commits, 2 files, updated 01:08 CST. Two things to check, unread: the PR body names round 2 PASS on b7c279a5, an older head than c8a2b89327f8; and this step is stopped with its lane stopped, so which session re-posts the record is not named. 01:56 CST Nov 15 (coordinator, relayed; coordinator's pick, undoable, not the owner's): lane session_013NEJKyz4g3abVfp77T7hNV owns PR 3464 and is ALIVE (get_session at 01:57 CST: running, connected, parent the coordinator, updated 01:57 CST; the 00:54 'stopped' line above was stale or wrong), so this step is doing, not stopped. The tool refused the lane's --fix-check (no earlier tool-form log at parent b7c279a5); its record 6890685566 was hand-posted and is void. Pick: a fresh Sonnet round 1 at c8a2b893, in the tool's first form; if the tool refuses that, the coordinator brings (a) a new PR or the owner's call. GitHub read 01:57 CST: #3464 open draft, head c8a2b89327f8, base db3134aba78d (main moved on), clean, 3 commits. Unread: the record comment, and whether main's move conflicts. Order (consultant 01:55 CST, relayed): #3464 is left out of the rule-text combine.

02:03 CST Nov 15 (coordinator's picks, undoable, not the owner's; relayed, triage read no diff): the lane ran round 1 on #3464 at c8a2b893 (haiku, FAIL) and the merge tool refused the record as a restart; its printed remedy is carry by tree via a new PR with the body line `Replaces #3464`. Round 1 found real defects (agents/reviewer.md:74 stale copy; the wording 'one or more fix verifiers, all FAIL'), so the lane fixes them in a new PR, fresh round 1, then closes #3464. The replacing PR number is not yet known. Lane settings-docs-stale-switch-text now waits on the replacing PR, not #3464. GitHub read 02:02 CST: #3464 open draft, head c8a2b89327f8, clean, 2 files, 3 commits, base db3134aba78d (main has moved).

Coordinator's pick on the line-38 clash: decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 line 38 says only 'round 2 FAIL with no fix check', while pr-review-record and merge.py round_three_refusal also open round 3 after a failed round 1 whose fix verifiers all FAIL; the pick adds that round-1 branch to line 38 (aligns the decision to the merge tool, no new owner ruling) and the coordinator asks whether the owner is needed.

Triage verdict, read at 02:03 CST: OPEN. No recorded owner ruling rules the round-1 branch. r9 says 'Round 3 runs only when round 2 FAILS.' own-833-a-done-at-fix-check settles only the pass case ('a guard or check change that failed round 1 and passed its fix check gets no round 3') and keeps 'Round 3 still runs after a round 2 fail.' own-741-a covers only a lint fix after a passed round. own-849-a and own-850-a (carry forms for a replacement PR and the lane lint) do not mention round 1 or a fix verifier. Item 858 asks a different case (a passing fix check with no round recorded at its head). The round-1 branch is written in the merge tool and pr-review-record text, not in an owner ruling. Also: PR #3464's own body already writes the round-1 branch into CLAUDE.md ('or a round 1 FAIL whose fix verifiers all FAIL'), so the rule text would state it as the owner's. The pick is low-stakes and undoable, so it can stand as the coordinator's pick; if it does, mark it so and reopen on the owner's word.

02:04 CST Nov 15 (consultant, relayed; consultant's pick, undoable, NOT the owner's; ruling own-round1-branch-a): option (a). The replacing PR for #3464 (number not yet known) and this lane write the round-1 branch (round 1 FAIL and every fix verifier FAIL opens round 3, as merge.py round_three_refusal and pr-review-record line 58 do) into decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3 and CLAUDE.md, labelled 'consultant pick 02:04 CST Nov 15, undoable', and make decision lines 15 and 38 agree. The label stays because no owner ruling rules this branch (triage's 02:03 CST read above). The decision edit and the line 15 vs 38 fix are for the same lane, in the same PR. The consultant tells the owner in one line; the owner may rule b (drop the branch from the tool), which reopens it.
